forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 9c80
+title: BlockingFIFOTests.theReaderReadsTheTextAfterItOpensThePipe fails at times in the full suite (EAGAIN)
+---
+In the full run of `timeout 1800 swift test --skip-build` on 2026-11-19 (during ^ck8e0sx), the test `theReaderReadsTheTextAfterItOpensThePipe()` in `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/BlockingFIFOTests.swift` recorded: `Caught error: Error Domain=NSCocoaErrorDomain Code=256 "The file couldn't be opened." ... NSPOSIXErrorDomain Code=35 "Resource temporarily unavailable"`. The suite alone (`--filter BlockingFIFOTests`) then passed 3 of 3 in 0.217 s. The diff of ^ck8e0sx does not touch this file or `BlockingFIFO`.
+
+Probable cause: the read end opens with `O_RDONLY | O_NONBLOCK` (`openReadEnd(at:)`), so a read (`readToEnd()`) or a step before the write can get EAGAIN when the system is loaded.
+
+## Change
+- [ ] Find the call that gets EAGAIN and make the test deterministic (for example, clear `O_NONBLOCK` on the read end after the write end opens).
+- [ ] The full suite passes with this test. #flaky #test
\ No newline at end of file
